TargetThreadId
The primary thread associated with this service.
TargetProcessId
The unique ID of a target process (in decimal, non-hex format). This field exists in almost all events, and it represents the ID of the process
that is responsible for the activity of the event in focus. For example, the TargetProcessId of a process that performed thread injection
in an InjectedThread event
